subject.title: Feature: Opt-in cross-channel visibility in TUI (mirror iMessage/Telegram activity)

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class TUI cross-channel observe/mirror mode, and should that mode be read-only, interactive, or limited to explicitly selected sessions?
rationale: Source inspection proves the current gap, but the requested fix crosses channel/session visibility, message delivery, and new CLI/config surface, so automation cannot choose the privacy and product boundary safely.

options.title: Read-only observe mode
options.body: Add an explicit default-off mode that displays authorized cross-channel activity without sending mirrored replies to other transports.

options.title: Interactive mirror mode
options.body: Allow bidirectional visible mirroring behind a stronger opt-in, accepting higher delivery and privacy risk.

options.title: No broad mirror mode
options.body: Limit core work to selected-session live updates and leave broader monitoring to logs, Control UI surfaces, or a future design.

recommendation.title: Read-only observe mode
recommendation.body: Add an explicit default-off mode that displays authorized cross-channel activity without sending mirrored replies to other transports.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current /new isolation behavior and adjacent TUI session-refresh history most relevant to the product boundary.
